title: 18047 - 18047/P1639/005689
engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
commonCauses: Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri and/or connections faulty
stepByStepSolution: Kontrol edin:  Measuring Block Readings for Accelerator Pedal
Kontrol edin:  Voltage Signals from ECM to Throttle Pedal (see factory repair manual)
Kontrol edin:  Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri and Connectors from ECM to Accelerator Pedal
technicalNotes: There are 2 sensors in the accelerator pedal, both should increase in the same direction as the accelerator is pressed but they have different scales. This means one counts from 0 to 100, while the other one counts from 0 to 50.
model: Cayenne, Macan, Panamera, 911, Taycan, A3, A4, A5, A6, A7, A8, Q3, Q5, Q7, Q8, Leon, Ibiza, Ateca, Arona, Tarraco, Octavia, Superb, Kodiaq, Karoq, Fabia, Scala, Passat, Golf, Jetta, Tiguan, Polo, Arteon, Touareg, Transporter, Caddy, Amarok, Scirocco
